Checking my likely roll outcomes from Electric Company, most nearby squares carry low or no rent since other players barely have houses, and I can always mortgage a railroad for emergency cash. Since building Vermont to 3 houses triples its rent from 90 to 270, that upside is worth it, so I'll build.
